sandbachFocus: Leaders Sandbach United travel to Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to bounce back from their most recent loss. Despite that setback, Sandbach remain top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, and they'll be heavy favourites against Alsager, who sit bottom with just 4 points and are winless in their last five matches.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host struggling Dawley Town on Saturday, a fixture that could see them stay close to Sandbach if results elsewhere go their way. AFC Bridgnorth, in third, face Eccleshall at home in a mid-table clash between two sides with genuine title aspirations. Wolverhampton Casuals entertain Wednesfield Community in a local derby that pits a high-flying sixth-placed team against a side trying to climb away from the lower half. Bilston Town, fifth and in excellent recent form, travel to Foley Meir in a key mid-table encounter. Barnton host Shawbury United in a fixture involving a side riding a two-game winning streak against one on a concerning five-match losing run. New Mills travel to Market Drayton Town in a lower-mid-table battle, while Crewe face Allscott Heath at home—both sides needing points from the bottom end of the table. Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town in a basement clash between two of the division's poorest performers, and Brereton Social entertain Widnes Town, a meeting of two struggling sides. On Wednesday evening, Brereton Social make the short trip to Wednesfield Community in a midweek fixture.
